source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Each friendly NECRONS MONSTER projects Distortion Fields, an Aura. Enemy units up to 6″ away are unravelling, improving the AP of attacks against them by 1. As any phase begins, each eligible NECRONS MONSTER can take 3 mortal wounds to extend its own field to 9″ for that phase. If you field multiple TRANSCENDENT C’TAN units, all of them require Reletavistic Tether.

Singularity Matrix (+55 points) • C’TAN SHARD OF THE DECEIVER only. The Lord of Deceit Aura adds 1 CP whenever an opponent uses a Stratagem to target one of their own units up to 12″ from this model.
Quantum Goad (+45 points) • C’TAN SHARD OF THE NIGHTBRINGER only. The model can declare a charge on a turn when it Advanced.
Animus Damper (+35 points) • C’TAN SHARD OF THE VOID DRAGON only. Once a turn as the enemy Shooting phase opens, choose an enemy VEHICLE unit the bearer can see. It takes a Leadership test. Its attacks take −1 to hit through phase end, with −1 to wound as well if it fails.
Reletavistic Tether (+40 points) • TRANSCENDENT C’TAN only. On your turn, the card lists Ingress and Advance, conditioned on using Transdimensional Displacement. That ability supplies an Advance trigger. With the Tether, the unit can finish that move beyond 6″ horizontally from every enemy unit, replacing 8″. A finish at most 8″ from any enemy unit bars the TRANSCENDENT C’TAN from declaring charges for the rest of the turn.

distortionFields.affects: each attack targeting an unravelling enemy unit

bindings.name: Singularity Matrix
bindings.trigger: opponent targets an opposing unit within the aura with a Stratagem

bindings.name: Animus Damper
bindings.recipientModelOnly: C’tan Shard of the Void Dragon
